title: Filter Error Logs
prompt: Implement `error_lines(log)` returning a new string containing only the lines that start with "ERROR", each kept as-is with its newline. No ERROR lines → empty string.

tests.name: filters
tests.code:
std::string out = error_lines(std::string{"INFO ok
ERROR bad
INFO fine
ERROR worse
"}); CHECK(out == std::string{"ERROR bad
ERROR worse
"});
tests.hint: Only ERROR lines, order preserved, newlines kept.

tests.name: prefix only
tests.hint: The line must START with ERROR — not merely contain it.
